title: Kissed Mustardy Chinese Udon Congee
description: A hearty and savory Chinese-inspired congee dish featuring chewy udon noodles, mustardy flavors, and a Mediterranean twist, perfect for a date night dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the whole mustard seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently.
Add the prepared mustard, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Add the udon noodles and reduce the heat to low, simmering for 10 minutes or until the noodles are cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the chopped green onions and serve the congee hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
